_comment: The Antaera campaign: everything the SRD ruleset leaves off, switched on.
Each entry names the wiki page it implements. The wiki is the authority - if
a number here disagrees with it, the wiki is right and this file is stale.
Fix it here and say so in the commit message.
This file is a layer, not a replacement: core.json still supplies sizes,
bonus types, the buy table and everything else common to the edition.
name: Antaera
tagline: The world of Antaera, as the DM runs it.
description: The campaign's own rules: gestalt, action points, taint, traits and flaws, and the restrictions on wealth and level adjustment. Characters start at 3rd level.

pointBuy.note: 30 points, spent from a base of 8 in each score.

rolled.note: Roll two arrays with !rollstats in your #scars-characters thread and keep one. Reroll an array totalling under 65 or over 85.

hitPoints.lockNote: Average or rolled is chosen once, at 2nd level, and holds for every level after.

wealth.craftingNote: Crafting for yourself at character creation cannot take an item below half its market price.
wealth.backgroundItemNote: Level 4+: a background item is worth no more than 1/4 WBL, and can be neither a Specific item nor part of a set. Levels 1-3 are agreed with the DM.

levelAdjustment.note: Starting LA may not exceed a quarter of your ECL, minimum +1 (or +0 for an LA +0 race). Exceptions are case by case.

traitsFlaws.note: Two traits and two flaws, each flaw buying one feat. No third-party or homebrew sources.

actionPoints.modeNote: Two readings of the page are possible. refresh is the printed variant: 5 + half your level, renewed at each new level, with unspent points not carried over. accumulate adds 5 + half the new level to the pool at every level. Set whichever the table actually plays.
actionPoints.note: Spent points are gone for good. One point per round, and a point spent on a special action is not also a point spent on a die roll.

taint.thresholdNote: Corruption is read against Constitution, depravity against Wisdom. Past the severe band a corrupted character dies and rises as a tainted minion; a depraved one goes mad and gains the tainted raver template.

pureSoul.note: Pure Soul: +4 on Corruption and Depravity saves, +1 more per Exalted feat you hold (the feat itself counts).

taint.evilSubtypeNote: A creature with the Evil subtype, and any undead, has corruption and depravity equal to half its Charisma score, +1 undead or +2 outsider, and takes no penalty from them.

gestalt.note: Each side trains at the same time rather than one after the other, so a level costs the longer of the two.
gestalt.lopsidedNote: When one class is more than twice the level of the other, it counts as 3/4 of its level for training time.

backgrounds.requiredNote: Every character picks one at 1st level.

dying.note: A dying character makes a DC 10 Constitution check each turn, with a penalty equal to its negative hit point total, to become stable. A natural 20 always works. Failure costs 1 hit point. Death comes at negative hit points equal to the Constitution score.
dying.actionPointNote: One action point makes a dying character stable at its current total.

content.note: 1st and 2nd party content only; no third-party or homebrew. ACFs, Dragon and Dungeon magazine and Savage Species content need the DM's approval. See The Index for the full list of banned and altered content.

restrictions.evenAbilityEnhancementsNote: Items that enhance ability scores come only in even numbers.
